## Checklist

- [ ] The summary above is written by me, a human, and explains what changes and why.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO).
- [ ] I have signed the [CLA](https://github.com/lajstrom/lajstrom/blob/main/CLA.md) (the CLA bot will ask on your first pull request).
- [ ] AI tools used for this change are disclosed with an `Assisted-by: <tool name>` trailer in the commits (or none were used).
- [ ] Tests are added or updated.
- [ ] An ADR is added in `docs/adr/` if the change is architectural.
- [ ] New or updated dependencies comply with the [dependency license policy](https://github.com/lajstrom/lajstrom/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#dependency-license-policy).
